title: Technical Writer/Sr. Technical Writer/Lead Technical Writer 1
description:
**Your role**
-------------

As a Technical Writer, you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining clear and accurate technical documentation for industrial products. You will collaborate with engineering and product teams to translate complex information into user\-friendly content, ensuring quality, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.


What we expect of you?


* Write, update and create Instruction books, quick start guide, product instructions
* Collect, evaluate, check and complete all information
* Possess the knowledge of, and accurately apply, the English language including the meaning of words, rules of composition, and grammar
* Align with priorities set by the Global team
* Develop strong product knowledge and understanding of target audience users and personas
* Organize material and complete writing assignments in accordance with set standards regarding order, clarity, style, and terminology to deliver high quality documentation
* Apply style guides and authoring checklists to maintain documentation quality
* Work with other writers, Product Managers, service/marketing team to identify gaps in documentation of functionality and complete the required documentation
* Publish and maintain templates for written documentation produced by others ensuring a consistent "look and feel."
* Work closely with technical authors and assess their work for correct and consistent use of the source language.

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

**Skills**

* Experience in authoring tools such as Oxygen, Adobe FrameMaker, Adobe InDesign, Word
* 3\+ years of experience as a Technical writer
* Ability to write English clearly and concisely using correct grammar, spelling, and punctuation
* Proven ability to write conceptual, task\-oriented, and reference documentation
* Experience with MS Office
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Experience writing to a style guide and to meet authoring requirements
* Experience with MS TEAMS to track your work and collaborate with the product teams
* Capable of effectively working with multiple stakeholders in cross\-cultural, global teams
* STE certification and course in Technical communication is an added advantage
* Well organized and able to operate independently
* Willing to accept the challenges and convert them into success.
* Good planner and systematic organizer.
* A team player that will share information with colleagues and help develop the group.

**Educational requirements**

Master or Bachelor of engineering


**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

* Culture of trust and accountability
* Lifelong learning and career growth
* Innovation powered by people
* Comprehensive compensation and benefits
* Health and well\-being

**Job location**
----------------

  

Option 2: Hybrid
  

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at our Hinjewadi Office in Pune.

title: Principal Technical Writer
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.


Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


**Your Role**

As a part of the User Assistance team, you will be responsible for creating quality documentation that helps users get the most out of their PTC product. You work closely with product design teams and help drive a consistent tone and voice across multiple documentation deliverables and products.


Your work involves writing about highly complex products and concepts, so you must have technical affinity.


You will also be involved in analyzing, reviewing and implementing SEO recommendations to provide customers with good experience


You will work with lead writers or UA managers to create, update, and maintain documentation for product releases for PTC products.


Ability to use AI\-enabled tools to support SDLC and knowledge or experience with AI, ML is an added advantage.


**Your Impact**

You will be responsible for developing and supporting user assistance deliverables for PTC products.


**Your Team**

You will be a part of the User Assistance team, reporting into a Manager. You will work with the product scrum teams and the lead/Principal writers in the Pune UA team.


**Your Day\-to\-Day**

* Create and update product documentation based on the assigned tasks, according to product release schedules.
* Apply PTC writing guidelines and documentation processes to be able to deliver user documentation of high quality as per PTC standards.
* Participate in daily standups; attend scrum meetings, product discussions, cross functional team meetings and so on.
* Support department initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with scrum teams for your product areas to gather information on product updates to be able to document it effectively.

Experience \- 7\+ Years


**Must\-Have Skills**

* BE/MCA/MS degree
* Proficiency in spoken and written English.
* Proficiency in technical writing and editing content.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Basic knowledge of the Microsoft Suite of products: Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  

  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.


If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?


We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."

title: Technical Writer
description:
**Position:** Offsite Author – C\&F  
**Location:** Pune (Magarpatta)  
**Experience:** 1\+ Years Preferred  
**Education:** 4\-Year Engineering Degree / Equivalent

About the Role

We are looking for **Offsite Authors – C\&F** to support our client’s technical documentation requirements. The ideal candidate should have an **Engineering background along with training or knowledge in Technical Writing/Technical Communication**.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and maintain **technical documentation** related to construction and equipment systems.
* Develop clear and accurate documentation for **repair, maintenance, and diagnostic procedures**.
* Understand and document technical information related to **hydraulics, electrical, and powertrain systems**.
* Collaborate with technical teams and subject matter experts to gather and validate information.
* Ensure documentation meets required quality, accuracy, and formatting standards.

Required Skills

* 4\-year **Engineering degree or equivalent**.
* **1\+ years of relevant experience** preferred.
* Training or knowledge in **Technical Writing / Technical Communication**.
* Good understanding of technical concepts and documentation processes.
* Exposure to any of the following will be an advantage:
* Construction Equipment
* Repair \& Maintenance
* Diagnostics
* Hydraulics
* Electrical Systems
* Powertrain Systems
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good attention to detail and ability to understand complex technical information.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with an **Engineering background and Technical Writing/Technical Communication training**, particularly those with exposure to construction equipment or related technical systems, are encouraged to apply.

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

title: Content Writer - Pharma & Medical
description:
Content Writer – Pharma \& Medical Domain

Location: Pune  
Experience: 4–6 Years

We are looking for an experienced **Content Writer** with strong knowledge of the **Pharma and Medical domain** to create accurate, engaging, and industry\-focused content.

Key Responsibilities:

* Create and edit **medical, pharmaceutical, and healthcare content**.
* Research and simplify complex medical/pharma information.
* Develop content for **websites, blogs, articles, reports, and marketing materials**.
* Ensure content is **accurate, clear, well\-researched, and grammatically correct**.
* Follow relevant **medical, pharmaceutical, and regulatory guidelines**.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts and internal teams.

Key Skills:

* 4–6 years of experience in **Content Writing**, preferably in Pharma/Medical/Healthcare.
* Strong **research, writing, editing, and proofreading** skills.
* Good understanding of **pharmaceutical and medical terminology**.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to create **technical and audience\-friendly content**.
